definitions.gloss: exhibiting, displaying (at an exhibition or show)
definitions.explanation: Submitting or displaying an item at an exhibition, trade show, or contest.

definitions.gloss: listing for sale, putting up for auction
definitions.explanation: Putting an item up for sale, especially on an online marketplace or at an auction.

examples.japanese: {美術展|びじゅつてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出品|しゅっぴん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I exhibited at the art exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出品|しゅっぴん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to submit a work to this year's contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{見本市|みほんいち}→見本市：14339_mihonichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出品|しゅっぴん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: We exhibited a new product at the international trade fair and attracted attention.

examples.english: I listed it on a flea market site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧な⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧オークション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出品|しゅっぴん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.japanese: {出品|しゅっぴん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一|いち}{時間|じかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised it sold within an hour of listing it.

notes:
Compound of {出|しゅつ} (to put out) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods, item). The word covers both formal exhibition contexts and everyday online selling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出品|しゅっぴん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exhibit, to list for sale)
- {出品|しゅっぴん}{者|しゃ} (exhibitor, seller)
- {出品|しゅっぴん}{物|ぶつ} (exhibited item, listed item)
- {出品|しゅっぴん}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (submitted work)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出品|しゅっぴん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exhibit at / list on)

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {出品|しゅっぴん} is frequently used for online marketplaces like メルカリ and ヤフオク in addition to its traditional meaning of exhibiting at shows or galleries.
